findings.governingReading: わからない is her failure to see why this tactical opportunity is dangerous; Shirou then explains he fears for her safety.
findings.explanation: Rin’s inability to understand Shirou’s objection becomes an accusation that he fails to understand.

findings.highlight: The black and white twin swords.
findings.governingReading: 夫婦, read めおと, frames the pair as husband and wife, not merely two similar weapons.
findings.explanation: The married-couple sword image becomes twin swords.
